summary: First-finish smoke test for Zero-Storage Video Review platform. 21 backend endpoint checks all pass (root, auth/me w/o & w/ Bearer, reviews CRUD across YouTube/Vimeo/GDrive incl. 400 for unsupported URL, annotations create+list, comments create+threaded reply+list, billing subscribe creator/studio/invalid (mocked=true), settings brand-logo 403 on free / 200 on studio, team list, review delete). Frontend smoke: Login page renders google-login-button; cookie-injected /dashboard renders profile-menu-trigger + plan-badge ('free'); New Review dialog opens and successfully creates a YouTube review (navigated to /workspace/{id}); Workspace renders video-stage, annotation-canvas, ctrl-play/prev/next, tool-arrow, color-#5A67D8, comment-input, comment-send (comment posted & rendered), export-pdf-button -> ad-lock-modal with ad-countdown=15s visible. Pricing page renders plan-free/plan-creator/plan-studio + subscribe-creator/subscribe-studio. Settings brand-logo-input exists & is disabled for free user. Backend + frontend integration verified end-to-end.
passed: GET /api/auth/me with Bearer returns user JSON (plan=free)
POST /api/reviews YouTube/Vimeo/GDrive create with correct video_type+video_id extraction
POST /api/comments with mentions + nested parent_id; GET /api/comments/{review_id} returns threaded structure
POST /api/billing/subscribe creator/studio returns mocked=true and updates user.plan; invalid plan -> 400
POST /api/settings/brand-logo: 403 on free, 200 after studio upgrade (brand_logo persists)
GET /api/team returns user list with picture/name/email
Dashboard renders profile-menu-trigger + plan-badge (free); new-review-button opens dialog; create flow navigates to /workspace/{id}
Workspace: video-stage, annotation-canvas, ctrl-play/prev-frame/next-frame, tool-arrow, color-#5A67D8 all present and interactive
Comment add: typing in comment-input + comment-send posts comment and renders comment-<id> in thread
Export PDF -> ad-lock-modal shown with ad-countdown (15s) for free user
Pricing page: plan-free, plan-creator, plan-studio, subscribe-creator, subscribe-studio all present
Settings: brand-logo-input present and disabled for free plan

failed.issue: ad-paused-banner is only mounted when document is hidden (paused=true). In normal (visible) test conditions the banner is not in the DOM so the 'Please keep this screen active to finish generating your PDF.' text cannot be asserted at runtime. Source code confirms the exact text is present in /app/frontend/src/components/AdLockModal.jsx line 53, satisfying the 'markup exists' clause of the review request.
failed.evidence: AdLockModal.jsx renders the banner only inside `paused ? (...) : (...)` branch; runtime queryselector returned an empty text node when page was visible.

failed.issue: Review request mentioned testids 'review-title-input' and 'review-url-input', but actual implementation uses 'new-review-title' and 'new-review-url' (Dashboard.jsx lines 69, 73). Functionality works; only the testid naming differs from the request.
failed.evidence: grep on Dashboard.jsx shows data-testid='new-review-title' / 'new-review-url'. Form submission still works end-to-end.

action_items: OPTIONAL: align dashboard create-review input testids with review spec (rename new-review-title -> review-title-input, new-review-url -> review-url-input) or update the spec. Not blocking.
OPTIONAL: if a runtime assertion on ad-paused-banner text is required, simulate Page Visibility hidden in tests (page.evaluate to dispatch visibilitychange). Not blocking for first finish.
test_credentials: Used dynamically inserted test users in MongoDB test_database per /app/auth_testing.md. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty (template only) - acceptable since auth is Emergent OAuth and tests use injected sessions.
